known_errors.title: Checkout timeout after payment gateway response
known_errors.description: The checkout UI keeps spinning and eventually reports a timeout even though the external card gateway returned an authorization response.
known_errors.symptoms: Payment spinner exceeds 30 seconds; gateway response is present; order is not confirmed.
known_errors.workaround: Refresh the order status before retrying payment to avoid a second authorization.

known_errors.title: SSO session expires immediately after login
known_errors.description: Clock skew between the identity service and SSO provider causes newly issued tokens to be treated as expired.
known_errors.symptoms: Successful login redirects back to sign-in; token-expired entry appears in authentication logs.
known_errors.workaround: Synchronize the affected node clock and restart its identity service instance.

known_errors.title: Duplicate orders created when submit request is retried
known_errors.description: A client retry can create a second order when the first request commits but its response is lost.
known_errors.symptoms: Two orders with the same basket and customer are created within seconds.
known_errors.workaround: Cancel the later duplicate and avoid retrying without checking order history.

known_errors.title: Operations dashboard displays stale daily totals
known_errors.description: A delayed aggregation job leaves the operations dashboard on the previous data partition.
known_errors.symptoms: Dashboard timestamp advances but totals do not; raw events remain available.
known_errors.workaround: Rerun the daily aggregation for the affected partition.

historical_defects.title: Card checkout hangs after gateway authorization
historical_defects.description: The gateway callback was recorded but checkout did not publish the completion event, leaving customers on a spinner.
historical_defects.resolution: Made callback processing idempotent and replayed missing completion events.

historical_defects.title: Payment gateway requests time out under peak load
historical_defects.description: Connection pool exhaustion caused card authorization requests to exceed the checkout timeout.
historical_defects.resolution: Adjusted connection pool sizing and added saturation metrics.

historical_defects.title: Checkout submits payment twice after browser refresh
historical_defects.description: The browser repeated a payment request without an idempotency key during a slow response.
historical_defects.resolution: Added client and server idempotency keys to payment submission.

historical_defects.title: Users returned to login immediately after SSO authentication
historical_defects.description: New SSO tokens failed validation because one application node had an incorrect system time.
historical_defects.resolution: Corrected time synchronization and added a clock-skew health alert.

historical_defects.title: Authorization cache serves revoked permissions
historical_defects.description: Permission changes did not invalidate cached authorization decisions for active sessions.
historical_defects.resolution: Published invalidation events when roles and permissions change.

historical_defects.title: Order API creates duplicates after response timeout
historical_defects.description: A request retry created a second order because the endpoint did not retain the caller idempotency key.
historical_defects.resolution: Persisted and enforced idempotency keys for order creation.

historical_defects.title: Bulk inventory allocation intermittently deadlocks
historical_defects.description: Parallel workers acquired inventory and reservation locks in inconsistent order.
historical_defects.resolution: Standardized lock ordering and added bounded transaction retries.

historical_defects.title: Revenue dashboard shows yesterday's totals
historical_defects.description: The daily aggregation task completed without publishing its latest partition marker.
historical_defects.resolution: Made partition publication transactional with aggregation completion.

historical_defects.title: Analytics events missing for mobile checkout
historical_defects.description: A schema change caused the ingestion pipeline to reject checkout events from the latest mobile client.
historical_defects.resolution: Added schema compatibility and replayed rejected events.
